purpose: Map portable governance Skills to optional execution backends without vendoring third-party Skill bodies, scripts, credentials, or project facts.

operating_rules.selection: Choose the smallest backend set that answers the task and prefer an already installed curated backend over a new installation.
operating_rules.authority: A registry entry is routing metadata, not authority to install packages, use credentials, consume API quota, upload data, or run a large job.
operating_rules.provenance: Record backend version or immutable ref, exact command or query, access date, inputs, outputs, failures, and evidence boundary in the project artifact.
operating_rules.fallback: If a backend is unavailable, report the missing dependency and keep the Skill usable in plan or review mode.
operating_rules.promotion: Promote a backend beyond tool-bound only after the named validation gate passes on a bounded fixture or project pilot.
operating_rules.rollback: Remove or disable the backend mapping; do not delete project data or rewrite Git history.

backends.license: plugin-distributed; verify bundled metadata and upstream source terms
backends.validation: discover the selected leaf Skill, run one bounded read-only lookup, and retain query provenance

backends.license: plugin-distributed; verify selected pipeline and dependency licenses
backends.network: optional for preflight; required for missing packages, references, or containers
backends.validation: run plugin preflight, review install_plan.json, then run a bundled or synthetic fixture before project data

backends.license: Apache-2.0 code; CC-BY-4.0 materials; source-specific terms also apply
backends.network: required for live databases and AlphaGenome
credentials: ALPHAGENOME_API_KEY when the selected workflow requires it
backends.validation: pin an immutable ref, inspect the selected Skill and scripts, then test one bounded use case without copying the corpus

backends.license: MIT for BioMCP; upstream database terms apply
backends.validation: run health checks and one counts-first cross-entity query; compare provenance and noise with source-specific curated Skills

backends.license: pipeline-specific open-source license; container and tool licenses vary
backends.network: required for first pull of pipeline, dependencies, references, or containers
backends.validation: pin pipeline release and run the official test profile in the target executor before project data

backends.network: depends on selected model, metadata providers, and document acquisition
credentials: model-provider key when not using a local model
optional metadata-provider keys for larger corpora
backends.validation: use a fixed small paper set with known answers; score citation location, unsupported statements, missing-document handling, privacy, and cost

backends.license: mixed Apache-2.0 and CC-BY-4.0; selected service/model terms may differ
backends.network: depends on selected local model, NIM, or hosted service
credentials: service-specific credentials when a hosted backend is selected
backends.validation: confirm task-method fit, pin the selected component, run a control or fixture, and keep model confidence separate from biological evidence

capabilities.deliverable: replayable entity-resolution and cross-database evidence table

optional_backends.use_when: a cross-entity counts-first query materially reduces repeated source routing

stop_conditions: entity identity or build is unresolved
required source terms or credentials are unavailable
the query would expose a credential or private dataset

capabilities.deliverable: sample-aware RNA workflow with QC, reproducible commands, results, and source data

preferred_backends.use_when: FASTQ-to-matrix execution needs a pinned portable production pipeline

stop_conditions: sample design or biological replicate is unresolved
reference or library chemistry is unresolved
preflight or official test profile fails

capabilities.deliverable: normalized variant or locus evidence table with QC and claim limits

optional_backends.use_when: the authorized task includes variant-calling execution rather than interpretation only
a bounded AlphaGenome single-variant effect analysis is method-matched and API quota use is explicitly authorized

stop_conditions: build, REF/ALT, effect allele, or transcript cannot be reconciled
the selected external workflow is single-variant but the research task is regional or sequence-window prediction
the task requests personal diagnosis or treatment advice
calling inputs or project authority are missing

capabilities.deliverable: reproducible screened paper set and decision-oriented evidence map

optional_backends.use_when: the user supplies a stable local full-text corpus and needs repeated evidence-grounded questions

stop_conditions: search scope or inclusion criteria are undefined
only metadata is available for a full-text claim
the corpus cannot be indexed without an unapproved external model or upload

capabilities.deliverable: fixed-paper claim-to-figure and method evidence map

optional_backends.use_when: multiple local full texts need repeatable retrieval with page or section citations

stop_conditions: paper version or access scope is unresolved
page or figure evidence is unavailable for the requested claim
the backend would upload private papers without approval

capabilities.deliverable: structure or docking hypothesis with locked inputs, controls, QC, and evidence limits

optional_backends.use_when: a selected model or NIM matches structure prediction, protein design, or protein-ligand docking after method review

stop_conditions: sequence, isoform, chain, residue, ligand, or partner mapping is unresolved
the selected backend does not match protein-protein versus protein-ligand task class
controls, model version, or output provenance cannot be retained
